name: AdminLTE
description_en: AdminLTE - Free admin dashboard template based on Bootstrap 5
readme_excerpt: AdminLTE — Bootstrap 5 Admin Dashboard AdminLTE is the most popular open-source admin dashboard template — fully responsive, built on Bootstrap 5.3 with vanilla JavaScript (no jQuery), highly customizable, and easy to use. It fits every screen from small mobile devices to large desktops, and it's MIT-licensed.
